record.original_question: Let ω be uniformly distributed on [0,T]. Is it true that, as T tends to infinity, max_{h in [0,1]} log|ζ(1/2 + i h + i ω)| = log log T - (3/4) log log log T + E, where the error term E stays bounded in probability?

evidence.quote: Problem 6.1. [39] Consider [0,T ] as a probability space, with normalised Lebesgue measure, and denote the corresponding variable by ω ∈ [0,T ]. Then, as T → ∞, one has max h∈[0,1] log|ζ(1/2+ih +iω)| = loglogT − 3/4 logloglogT +E, where the error term E is bounded in probability as T → ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\zeta$ denote the Riemann zeta function. For $T>0$, let $\omega$ be a random variable uniformly distributed on $[0,T]$ (with normalised Lebesgue measure as the probability measure). Define the random variable
$$M(T) \;=\; \max_{h\in[0,1]} \log\bigl|\zeta\bigl(\tfrac{1}{2} + i h + i\omega\bigr)\bigr|.$$
Prove or disprove that, as $T\to\infty$,
$$M(T) \;=\; \log\log T \;-\; \tfrac{3}{4}\,\log\log\log T \;+\; E_T,$$
where the error term $E_T$ is bounded in probability (i.e., for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $K=K(\varepsilon)$ such that $\Pr(|E_T|>K)<\varepsilon$ for all sufficiently large $T$).
artifact.status_search_result: This is the Fyodorov–Hiary–Keating conjecture for the Riemann zeta function. The upper bound (tightness from above) was established by Arguin, Bourgade, and Radziwiłł (2020, "The Fyodorov–Hiary–Keating Conjecture. I"), and the matching lower bound, completing tightness of the centered maximum, was proved in their 2023 follow-up "The Fyodorov–Hiary–Keating Conjecture. II". Together these confirm the conjectured asymptotic with bounded-in-probability error.

status_evidence.title: The Fyodorov-Hiary-Keating Conjecture. I
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bound: the measure of t in [T,2T] with max_{|h|≤1}|ζ(1/2+it+ih)| > e^y log T/(log log T)^{3/4} is ≤ C y e^{-2y}.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the upper bound part of the FHK conjecture matching the predicted log log T − (3/4) log log log T centering.

status_evidence.title: The Fyodorov-Hiary-Keating Conjecture. II
status_evidence.snippet: Proves matching lower bound on the maximum of ζ in a typical short interval; together with Part I implies tightness of the maximum, confirming the FHK conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Completes the proof of the conjecture, yielding bounded-in-probability error term.
